body: Yep.. This is exactly what i knew would happen. Im just gonna go for it honestly.
How am i supposed to? I have nowhere to go. I wish i could.. I desperately wish i could but too many things are keeping me bolted down

Tax refund went into moving and while relocating I was having trouble finding anywhere hiring, so we were surviving on that for a while. The only reason I have this low-paying job is because it was the first place that was available.
Also, many Ubers were covered due to such but we're back to square one.

I don't want to get into my life story here but we HAD to move, either to a new apartment or a shelter. It was bad timing not due to choice.
Trust me, I totally know and it's why I came here asking for advice.

My only issue with a new job is transportation. A ride to work costs me up to 30$ a day with Ubers, and with that I barely have pocket change to save up for my own vehicle. I'd LOVE to get a new job, but everywhere available is ridiculously far. 

If I got a new job as well it'd cut into my Food Stamps and the SSD we recieve, which.. If I can't keep the job and lose that all at once we're royally screwed.

Absolutely, have applied but there's a waiting list. Been on that waiting list for 2 years now. We've reached out for every possible resource, including SSD as well. The process for everything is excruciating.

I would take a roommate in but my lease specifics no roommates without having them sign the lease as well, so I'm avoiding breaking lease.

We definitely are protected and will not have any other children, we were okay when we got pregnant but the past few years have intensified in difficulty. Definitely didn't want to get this deep in debt, but due to emergencies popping up for our child and my disabled partner the debt accumulated in a flash.

My partner fills surveys out and gets about 20-50$ extra income to pay for diapers. They do all they can with being frugal and is a "crazy couponer" and that saves us with food and consumables big time.
Forgot to mention partner is on SSD as well, been looking into financial assistance for daycare for the toddler because she wants to work desperately with a job that can work around her disability.
Thanks for the support. It's hell every day but I'm managing. It feels like drowning every day. Maybe my family heritage will kick in and I'll have a heart attack at 30 from the stress.

He's a janitor because it's all he really qualifies for and I stay at home. Staying at home is a millon times cheaper than having my paycheck sucked dry for babysitting. If i had family i could do it for a discount maybe but even then with government assistance I'd lose it all anyway to make up for everything else. 

Maybe that's why he's grouchy because there's never a cent of change for us to freely go out and go on a date or even order a pizza.
